
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- 02_esp32_only_pins.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp8266` to volt.toml: chip = "esp8266"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp8266
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[red bold]-- HARDWARE ERROR -- 02_esp32_only_pins.volt:4[/red bold]

GPIO 34 does not exist on ESP8266. ESP8266 has GPIO 0-16 only.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin sensor: Analog = 34
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]        ^^^^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Available output pins: 4, 5, 12, 13, 14, 16[/cyan]
